Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You support your price with market movements, yet your earlier letter confirms fixed-price alloy coverage; it seems the key distinction is which increases actually reach your costs. We want to continue our partnership on a transparent price basis that reflects actual cost exposure. How can you substantiate the proposed price through the XLSX cost breakdown your owner offered to discuss, separating hedged material costs from the remaining cost drivers?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Using your own cost shares (AS-14404 45%, LCI-C 5%, PPI-C2431 38%) and the latest six-month index moves (AS-14404 -0.3% (idx:AS-14404@2026-03, idx:AS-14404@2026-09), LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2431 +9.7%), your cost increase comes to about +3.6% of the price, not +11.0%. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.73 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.70 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month volume and the prompt 14-day payment terms.
Because our alloy costs are fixed until March 2027, recent index drops do not reduce our current costs; however, we can support a 24-month contract by including an AS-14404 index clause.
With these terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.49 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €5.49 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You repeatedly stress your fixed alloy costs while proposing an index clause; it seems protecting current cost recovery and future exposure matters most to you. We want contractual certainty and prompt payment to earn a measurable reduction in the base price. How can you price that exchange while ensuring index adjustments begin only after your fixed-price cover ends?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%. We have a qualified alternative for this part and will place the volume where the total cost is best; we would prefer to keep it with you.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.80 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 5% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.84 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 5% deadband), 45 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You repeatedly emphasise index protection, while your earlier letter says alloy costs are covered at fixed prices; it seems protection against future exposure matters more than current market movements. We value the partnership and want a transparent price basis that distinguishes covered costs from future exposure. How can you share the cost-breakdown spreadsheet your owner offered to explain, so we can establish a defensible base price and align any adjustment with when your costs actually change?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.88 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 5% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
